steps.title: Setup App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the core app identification metadata including package name and application name.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Define build.gradle settings with targets matching Android SDK 34, Java 17 toolchain, and AGP 8.3.2 requirements.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish the AndroidManifest.xml setup including launching activity, permissions, and app themes targeting Android SDK 34.

steps.title: Create SQLite Helper Database Layer
steps.description: Write the database helper Java class utilizing SQLiteOpenHelper to manage structured tables for Notes and Categories.

steps.title: Implement Note and Category Data Models
steps.description: Define pure Java object representations for Note elements and Categories to facilitate clean structured data transfer.

steps.title: Design List Item UI Layout
steps.description: Construct the XML layout for single note list entries displaying titles, snippets, dates, and category tags.

steps.title: Design Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Implement main interface containing note lists, filtering dropdowns, search query bars, and actions.

steps.title: Design Note Editor Layout
steps.description: Build layout XML for inserting or updating records, including fields for title, category selections, and body content.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Logic
steps.description: Write the controller logic of MainActivity to fetch, search, category-filter, and display structured note cards dynamically.

steps.title: Implement NoteEditorActivity Logic
steps.description: Implement standard activity mechanics to handle notes generation, updating database instances, category creation, and safe deletion flows.

steps.title: Verify Code Cleanliness and UI Polish
steps.description: Conduct dynamic checks on layouts, lists, search, filtering, and Java 8 anonymous inner compatibility.

steps.title: Building Categorized Notes
steps.description: Trigger local gradle compiler wrapper execution to generate final build binaries.
